location_lifecycle.label: Studio & Facility Lifecycle
location_lifecycle.help: Operational lifecycle of a studio, stage, or edit suite. Occupancy, booking availability, and record activation are separate.

planned.help: The studio, stage, or edit suite is being prepared and has not started operating.

operational.help: The studio, stage, or edit suite is operating. This does not indicate vacant space or booking availability.

under_maintenance.help: The studio, stage, or edit suite is undergoing maintenance; operating restrictions are managed separately.

temporarily_closed.help: Operations at the studio, stage, or edit suite are paused with an intention to reopen.

closed.help: Operations have ended at the studio, stage, or edit suite.
